title: The 9th Vanilla Level Design Contest - Abstract Map
description:
The Vaporwave styled Abstact Map theme from VLDC9.
This version fixes the write to 0 MVOL, so now your music won't screw up. I also included a new optimized version for use with sound effects.
Update: fixes the awful echo feedback on the optimized version

Also known as Can You Feel.
